about.text: A Soviet-era fermented milk drink, created in the Armenian SSR in the 1930s. Pasteurised cow's milk is soured with Lactobacillus acidophilus, kefir grains and lactic streptococci, at no lower than 32 °C for 10 to 12 hours.

sources.text: The starter, temperature and time, and the Armenian origin, from these.
